name: en_onboard_learn
title: English UI — LEARN journey, learning Spanish from scratch
persona: An English speaker who wants to learn Spanish from zero. We walk the full LEARN onboarding graph (welcome → pickPrimary → fork[learn] → pickLearning → calibrateLearn → pickPhrasePacks → tts → interests → finish) all the way to Home, screenshotting every step.

beats.narrate: Fresh first run — clear onboarding + landing, land on a clean URL.
Welcome — animated multilingual word cloud + Corpán wordmark.
Begin (the purple Next arrow).
Pick primary (UI) language — the celebratory ~50-language list.
Choose English as the UI / primary language.
Fork — What brings you to Corpán?
Pick the LEARN journey.
Pick languages to learn — drag-orderable stack (English at the bottom = UI).
Add Spanish as the target language (the add-language chip).
Verify Continue is reachable in the pinned footer.
Continue to calibration (footer primary).
Calibrate — Have you studied Spanish before?
Never — total beginner (A0, slowest speech).
Pick your topics — starter phrase packs (all pre-selected).
Keep the full starter shelf, Continue (footer primary).
Text-to-speech setup — voice picker for Spanish (+ English).
beats.wait_text: Tap a voice to hear it

beats.narrate: Accept the auto-picked voices, Continue (footer primary).
Interests — What do you want to do? (skippable multi-select).
beats.wait_text: What do you want to do?

beats.narrate: Pick a couple of interests to seed recommendations.
Also Practice speaking.
Continue (footer primary).
Finish / engagement page — You're all set + socials.
Start exploring → commit + land on Home.
Home — the For you hero + Recommended + packs.
Confirm the Settings gear is present and on-screen.
Confirm the For-you hero CTA (Try it / Get) is present.
